newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-National Power brings A$250 mln bond.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-National Power brings A$250 mln bond.

text.p: BZW Australia said on Friday it had launched a A$250 million domestic bond issue for National Power Plc at a spread of 69 basis points over the Australian government October 2007 bond.
The bonds, which mature on February 21, 2007, pay an 8.0 percent coupon.
The issue was rated A early this month by Standard & Poor's.

At the time of rating the issue was expected to be A$400 million, but market conditions saw this reduced to a size that would be readily taken up by local investors, a spokesman for the lead manager said.

He added that the issuer had been looking to issue a Eurosterling bond, but this did not prove cost-effective and National Power also wanted to diversify and show commitment to that Australian investor base.
The transaction forms part of the final financing of National Power's acquisition of Hazelwood Power, a power station in the Australian state of Victoria.
Commonwealth Bank of Australia and Deustche Morgan Grenfell Australia are co-managers on the transaction.
